user_input: According to AA24-109A, which ATT&CK technique is connected to Akira threat actors through the reported use of Mimikatz? Explain the two-hop actor-to-software-to-technique path with evidence.
response:
Akira threat actors use Mimikatz. [E1, E2, E3, E4]
Mimikatz is connected to Defense Evasion technique. [E1, E4]
The two-hop actor-to-software-to-technique path is: Akira threat actors -> Mimikatz -> Defense Evasion. [E1, E2, E3, E4]
